findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_llms_txt · Private data: validate_llms_txt, generate_llms_txt, calculate_ai_time_saved, score_ai_readiness · Public sink: calculate_ai_time_saved, check_job_ai_risk · Destructive: run_aeo_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_llms_txt · Private data: validate_llms_txt, generate_llms_txt, calculate_ai_time_saved, score_ai_readiness · Public sink: calculate_ai_time_saved, check_job_ai_risk · Destructive: run_aeo_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
